_readme: Every photo and film slot on the homepage. Drop a file with the matching name into src/assets/media/ (photos) or public/media/ (films), then write its alt text here: one plain sentence describing the photo for people who can't see it. Leave a slot empty and the page shows a placeholder. focal = which part of the photo must stay in frame when it is cropped ("50% 30%" = centre, upper third).
